_note: cfMesh (cartesianMesh) profile. Merged only when mesher = cfmesh, before the case config, so a project can retune the engine once. The keys, their defaults and their descriptions are declared in src/rapidfoam/meshers/cfmesh/keys.py and documented in docs/meshers.md.
_override_how: Repeat a key in your case config, or drop configs/meshers/cfmesh.json in your project to override the shipped profile for every case.
